planner.system_prompt:
Choose job-shop dispatch rules to minimize makespan. The machines are split into 4 groups by index: group g holds the machines m with m*4//M == g, where M is the number of machines. Each group uses its own dispatch rule; every operation is scored by the rule of the machine it runs on, and a deterministic constructor schedules every operation in precedence order, always taking the ready operation with the best score (ties by job index).
Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly four keys, "group0" to "group3", each holding the rule name for that machine group:
{"group0":"est_spt","group1":"est_spt","group2":"est_spt","group3":"est_spt"}
Allowed rule names (use each name exactly):
est_spt: earliest start, then shortest processing time
job_ready: earliest job availability
ratio: smallest (earliest start + 1)/(remaining job work + 1)
fifo: lowest next operation index
completion: earliest operation completion
Pick the rule for each group independently. No extra keys, explanations, Python, or Markdown.
